name: 多 Key 轮换池
author: NethielChou
description: 把 DSH 里已配置的供应商/模型手动加入轮换池：额度用完自动按顺序切到下一条，可跨不同供应商切换（同一供应商内的多个模型不会互相兜底）；侧边栏面板支持勾选、排序，并显示当前路由、冷却与最近切换记录。
descriptionEn: Manually add your configured provider/model routes to a failover pool. When a route runs out of quota the next healthy route from a different provider is used in the same turn (same-provider candidates are skipped). A sidebar panel lets you pick, order, and watch the live route, cooling providers, and recent switches.
